name: Salesforce
shortInfo: Sync data from your data warehouse to Salesforce
brief: Using Salesforce, you can now close more deals quickly & create strong customer relations. The largest enterprise app ecosystem that is flexible and scalable to suit any business.
about:
Salesforce is the world’s most trusted customer relationship management (CRM) platform. We help your marketing, sales, commerce, service and IT teams work as one from anywhere — so you can keep your customers happy everywhere.  
  
Learn more about [Salesforce](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_list.htm).
availableSync:
[Salesforce Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/salesforce/syncs/salesforce-report.html)

This sync can be used to request and retrieve objects, fields and records data from a user specified data warehouse and send it to the Salesforce platform.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/salesforce/index.html) here.
